pages.text: It is said that during the age of legends, the Piglins waged war against the Overworld. After their defeat and decline, they left behind $(l)ruins that no longer shine with their former glory$(). Some claim that the Piglins still preserve a scroll containing their ancient knowledge, hidden somewhere within the $(l)Nether$().
These scrolls are said to be found within $(l)Bastion Remnant$().
